VERDICT goal: the node's goal is to group every catalogued archive variable by component and by repeated field pattern; imas_codex/discovery/signals/archive_grouping.py:156 rebuild() writes each selector as a component, control-node or ungrouped member and derives both an exact category+field-set pattern and a category union, and docs/evidence/fragments/iter-signal-context-and-enrichment/signals-grouped-by-component-and-pattern.html:8 reports the live run over 995,006 variables with 27,253 component groups, 1,777 control-node groups, 1,802 exact patterns and 413 category patterns.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when asks for a pytest gate with zero added failures plus a landing record of coverage, counts, distribution, singleton share, twenty largest patterns, description counts and a non-adding repeat; the manifest's baseline_suite records 60 passed EXIT=0 at e5ea75431 and schema-gate.log records 125 passed EXIT=0 at 4f5d97cc2, parentage-gate.log 4 passed EXIT=0 at 35392fccd, and the fragment's numbers reconcile with schema-grouping-receipt.json (995006/457619/491732/45655 variables, 27253/1777/1802/413 groups, repeat adds 0) in this reviewer's own read.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared fence is the six source and test directories plus the node fragment and its figure directory; git diff --stat 225707a 47037b02f lists exactly the 14 files the node goal names and every one is inside it or named in the goal.
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete, commits 2722a1bd1 through 47037b02f, changed_paths the 14 files in the range, negative_control_log convention-negative-control.log (2 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1), baseline_suite and after_suite both failure_count 0 with completed true.
VERDICT diff: read the five commits against 225707a; 2722a1bd1 rewrites the parser and both grouping stores, 4f5d97cc2 adds name_schema_counts and the figure script, 0e2b7f710 bounds the figure ticks, 35392fccd extends the retire query to legacy parentage, 47037b02f rewrites the evidence fragment and adds grouping.svg, and no removed test leaves a behaviour it covered uncovered (test_catalogue_pass_is_not_limited_to_one_cohort_or_facility survives as the facility=None assertion at tests/discovery/test_archive_name_parser.py:219).
